description: PAID: US$0.02 per successful autonomous x402 call, or 1 Horse Truth direct credit. Return one named derived Horse Truth signal for a horse, such as readiness, biomechanics, progression, trouble watch, class, reliability, alerts or winning conditions. signal=race_day_signals returns every race-day signal Horse Truth measured for the horse (ran better than its finish, beat the day's track pattern, running profile, form turning point). Use this tool when you need one named signal only (for example readiness or class_rating). Use horse_snapshot instead for several signals at once, and horse_intelligence for everything. signal=stride_measures returns the horse's stride measures from race tracking data: held its stride late, lifted its stride rate late, stride against its own runs and stride type.

horse.description: Horse name as printed in an Australian form guide, e.g. 'Chance With Wolves'. Case and country suffixes like (NZ) are ignored. If unsure of the exact name, call resolve_horse first.

signal.description: Which single signal to return. One of the listed values, e.g. 'readiness'.

name: horse_signal
